Footer.description: Empowering the next generation of DNS administrators through hands-on, risk-free learning experiences.

About.mission-description: ZeroCentDNS is committed to democratizing {{highlight}}DNS education{{/highlight}}. We believe that everyone should have access to hands-on learning opportunities without financial barriers.
About.edufirst-description: Every feature is designed with learning in mind, providing clear feedback and educational resources.
About.efficiency-description: Clean, intuitive interface that focuses on what matters most - your learning experience.
About.community-driver-description: Built for and supported by the open-source community, students, and educational institutions.
About.partnership-details: Even the smallest step, taken together, can lead to great progress.

Hero.risk-free-description: ZeroCentDNS provides a safe educational environment to master DNS concepts through delegated subdomains. Perfect for students, developers, and businesses exploring DNS.

Features.edufocus-description: Designed specifically for learning DNS concepts in a safe, controlled environment.
Features.for-everyone-description: Perfect for students, developers, open-source community, and small businesses.
Features.full-dns-control-description: Practice configuring A, AAAA, MX, CNAME, and other DNS record types.
Features.6month-description: Each subdomain remains active for 6 months, ensuring efficient resource usage.
Features.nocost-description: No cost, no commitment. Learn without the fear of breaking production systems.
Features.handson-description: Get practical experience before investing in your own top-level domain.
Features.why-description: A comprehensive platform designed to make DNS learning accessible, practical, and completely free for everyone.

AbusePage.helpuse-description: Help us maintain a safe and educational environment by reporting any misuse of ZeroCentDNS subdomains or services.

AbusePage.report-through-our-public-issue-tracker: Report through our public issue tracker

EmailOffer.title: Get Your Own Email Service
EmailOffer.description: Just like Disroot, we offer a free email service for your {{highlight}}[unique-name]@zcdns.id{{/highlight}} subdomain. Enjoy privacy-focused communication with your own custom email address.

Partners.proudly-supported-by: Our platform is proudly supported by industry leaders who share our commitment to education.

GrantsPage.title: Grants & Donations
GrantsPage.subtitle: Help us sustain and grow the ZCDNS ecosystem. Your support is crucial.
GrantsPage.no-free-service-title: There's no such thing as a free service on the Internet!
GrantsPage.no-free-service-reason: While ZCDNS is free for users, maintaining servers, network infrastructure, and development requires real-world costs. Your donation directly supports these operational expenses and allows us to remain independent and ad-free.
GrantsPage.benefit-sustainability: Support the sustainability of an open and educational ecosystem.
GrantsPage.benefit-free-dns: Free DNS hosting for your own domain or a custom [custom].zcdns.id subdomain.
GrantsPage.monetary-description: Choose your preferred method. Every contribution, big or small, makes a difference.
GrantsPage.hardware-description: If you have any hardware that could be used for the project, please get in touch with us. We cover shipping costs from within Indonesia.
GrantsPage.hardware-examples: Examples: Memory modules, servers, CPUs, hard drives, Raid/Network Cards, network equipment, etc. Any piece of hardware is welcome. Things we can't use, we can sell to cash out. We are also looking forward to any rack-space propositions.
GrantsPage.hardware-shipping: For hardware shipments from within Indonesia, we will cover the shipping costs with our designated courier.
GrantsPage.contact-description: To arrange a donation or ask any questions, please contact us via Telegram or Email.
GrantsPage.illustration-alt: Illustration of people brainstorming and collaborating on a project.
GrantsPage.monetary-contact-description: For donations, you can contact us via email:
GrantsPage.scam-warning: Scam Warning: We never provide bank account numbers, PayPal, or crypto wallet addresses except through our official email at funding@zcdns.id. Please be careful of scam attempts.
